items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: That was seven pieces too, a six piece band and a girl singer. Teresa Kelly was the girl singer.

ctx.x: Sometimes we had neither. That wasn't easy, huh?

No. We used to go down and play at Buris, at Buck Jones's in Buris for I believe $35, covering transportation and everything on Saturday night. That was seven pieces too, a six piece band and a girl singer. Teresa Kelly was the girl singer. Were you familiar with Teresa? Another name somewhere. About seventh piece with Teresa Greer stuff.
